Replay transaction scheduling state machine and task APIs for blocks, forks, and execution.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_sched` interface, which manages replay scheduling for blocks and transactions. It builds on `fd_rdisp` to control lane use, fork-aware block staging, block eviction, and task priority during replay execution. The file also defines the data structures used to describe FEC sets, block start and end events, transaction execution, sigverify work, and other scheduler tasks. The public functions provide memory sizing, creation, ingestion of block data, task dispatch, task completion, block abandonment, root updates, and access to stored transaction and PoH data.
